findings.summary: Seven absl subpackages (algorithm, cleanup, functional, memory, meta, types, utility) have no BUILD.bazel files; only their original CMakeLists.txt files are present under the converted workspace directories
findings.evidence: absl/CMakeLists.txt:17-37 calls add_subdirectory() for all 16 subpackages including algorithm, cleanup, functional, memory, meta, types, utility. Each has a CMakeLists.txt defining multiple absl_cc_library() and absl_cc_test() targets (functional: any_invocable, bind_front, function_ref, overload + 4 tests; types: optional, variant, any, span, compare etc. + tests; algorithm: algorithm, algorithm_container + 2 tests). The converted workspace under elements/abseil/absl/{algorithm,cleanup,functional,memory,meta,types,utility}/ contains only the original CMakeLists.txt with no BUILD.bazel file.

findings.summary: All cc_test targets absent from every converted per-module BUILD.bazel; 232 absl_cc_test() definitions in CMake have no Bazel equivalents
findings.evidence: CMake defines absl_cc_test() rules throughout all modules: base alone has ~30 tests (atomic_hook_test, nullability_test, raw_logging_functional_test, etc. starting at line 81); strings has ~50 tests; container, debugging, flags, log, hash, crc, numeric, profiling, random, status, synchronization, time each have multiple tests. grep for cc_test across all converted BUILD.bazel files returns 0 matches; strings/BUILD.bazel has 0 cc_test rules vs 50 absl_cc_test() calls in CMake.

findings.summary: ABSL_DEFAULT_LINKOPTS is defined in configure_copts.bzl but never applied to any cc_library rule; all linkopts silently dropped across the entire build
findings.evidence: configure_copts.bzl:36 defines ABSL_DEFAULT_LINKOPTS as a select() with platform-specific flags including MSVC -ignore:4221. Every absl_cc_library() in CMake that has sources passes LINKOPTS ${ABSL_DEFAULT_LINKOPTS} (e.g. debugging/CMakeLists.txt:28-29 for borrowed_fixup_buffer, container/CMakeLists.txt for multiple targets, etc.). grep for 'linkopts' across all converted absl/*/BUILD.bazel files returns 0 matches — the attribute is never used.

findings.summary: Conditional -lrt linkopt dropped from absl::base; breaks on Linux with glibc <2.17 or musl where clock_gettime lives in a separate librt
findings.evidence: absl/base/CMakeLists.txt:17 calls find_library(LIBRT rt) and line 276 passes $<$<BOOL:${LIBRT}>:-lrt> in the LINKOPTS of absl_cc_library(base). The converted base/BUILD.bazel cc_library for absl_base has no linkopts attribute at all.

findings.summary: Conditional execinfo linkopt dropped from absl::stacktrace; breaks FreeBSD and systems where backtrace() requires a separate libexecinfo
findings.evidence: absl/debugging/CMakeLists.txt:17 calls find_library(EXECINFO_LIBRARY execinfo) and line 71 passes $<$<BOOL:${EXECINFO_LIBRARY}>:${EXECINFO_LIBRARY}> in the LINKOPTS of the stacktrace absl_cc_library. The converted debugging/BUILD.bazel stacktrace cc_library has no linkopts attribute.

findings.summary: TESTONLY public helper libraries exception_testing, exception_safety_testing, and atomic_hook_test_helper absent from converted base/BUILD.bazel
findings.evidence: absl/base/CMakeLists.txt defines three TESTONLY libraries with public headers: exception_testing (line 311, header internal/exception_testing.h), exception_safety_testing (line 335, header + cc source, used by downstream test authors), and atomic_hook_test_helper (line 369, source internal/atomic_hook_test_helper.cc). These are exposed as usable test utilities when ABSL_BUILD_TEST_HELPERS=ON. None appear as cc_library targets in the converted base/BUILD.bazel.

findings.summary: MinGW-conditional -ladvapi32 linkopt dropped from absl::base; breaks Windows MinGW toolchain builds needing advapi32 for crypto/registry APIs
findings.evidence: absl/base/CMakeLists.txt:277 passes $<$<BOOL:${MINGW}>:-ladvapi32> in the LINKOPTS of absl_cc_library(base). The converted base/BUILD.bazel cc_library for absl_base has no linkopts attribute and no Windows-specific select() for this dependency.
